title: Cause and Effect in Informational Texts
summary: إزاي تعرف في النص المعلوماتي إيه السبب وإيه النتيجة، وتفهم سلسلة الأسباب والنتائج من كلمات الربط.

blocks.text: الدرس ده عن إيه؟

text: A **cause** is why something happens. An **effect** is what happens as a result. Informational texts (reports, articles, leaflets) often explain problems by showing their causes and effects.

blocks.text: الدرس ده عن سؤالين بسيطين جدًا: **ليه حصل كده؟** (ده السبب = **cause**) و**حصل إيه بعد كده؟** (دي النتيجة = **effect**). النصوص المعلوماتية (informational texts) زي التقارير والمقالات العلمية مليانة أسباب ونتايج، والامتحان بيسألك عليهم كتير.

في الكتاب المهارة دي في **Unit 4** (تقرير رسمي عن **أسباب ونتايج هدر الأكل food waste**)، وفي **Unit 5: The Greenhouse Effect** (أسباب ونتايج التغير المناخي). الكتاب بيقول في أهداف Unit 5: «analyze informational texts … to identify the **causes, effects and evidence** of climate change» وعنده جدول اسمه **Cause-and-Effect Structure** بيعرّف المهارة: «Show the relationship between **why** something happens (cause) and **what happens as a result** (effect).»
الفكرة ببساطة: «علشان كده»

text: Ask two questions: **Why?** → the answer is the cause. **What happened next?** → the answer is the effect. The cause always happens first.

blocks.text: فكّر فيها زي الدومينو: أول قطعة بتقع (السبب) فبتوقّع اللي بعدها (النتيجة). مثال من حياتك: «سهرت على الموبايل ← صحيت متأخر ← اتأخرت على المدرسة». كل خطوة هي نتيجة للي قبلها وسبب للي بعدها. ده اسمه **cause-and-effect chain** (سلسلة أسباب ونتائج).

items.en: Families buy more food than they need, **so** a lot of it goes off before it is eaten.
items.ar: السبب: بيشتروا أكتر من احتياجهم. النتيجة: الأكل بيبوظ. كلمة **so** = علشان كده.

items.en: **Because** temperatures are rising, glaciers are melting faster.
items.ar: السبب: الحرارة بتزيد. النتيجة: الجليد بيدوب. **because** قبل السبب.

items.en: Melting ice **leads to** rising sea levels.
items.ar: السبب: الجليد اللي بيدوب. النتيجة: مستوى البحر بيعلى. **leads to** = بيؤدي إلى.

blocks.title: حيلة لمعرفة الاتجاه
blocks.text: حط الجملة في القالب ده: «**عشان** (السبب) **حصل** (النتيجة)». لو المعنى منطقي يبقى إنت مرتّبهم صح. مثال: «عشان الحرارة زادت، الجليد داب» ✓ ، لكن «عشان الجليد داب، الحرارة زادت» ✗.
كلمات الربط اللي بتدلّك على السبب والنتيجة

text: Signal words help you find causes and effects. Some come **before the cause**, others come **before the effect**. Notice what follows each one: a noun phrase, a full clause, or a new sentence.

blocks.text: ده الجدول اللي الكتاب بيعرضه في Unit 5 (جزء Writing in Action: كلمات الربط بتاعة السبب والنتيجة)، ومعاه شرح لكل كلمة. أهم حاجة في القراءة: تعرف الكلمة دي **قبلها إيه وبعدها إيه**.

rows: **Because** the ice is melting, sea levels are rising.
The bread was stale, **so** they threw it away.
**as a result / as a consequence / consequently / therefore**
جملة جديدة (بعد نقطة أو في أولها)
Sea levels rose. **As a result**, many homes were flooded.
**the reason for … is / one cause of … is**
**One cause of** food waste **is** poor planning.
**the effect of … is / … has an impact on**
بعد of = **السبب**، وبعد is = **النتيجة**. وبعد has an impact on = **الحاجة المتأثرة**
**The effect of** warm water on coral **is** bleaching. / Heat **has an impact on** coral reefs.

blocks.title: فخ مشهور: result in ≠ result from
items: **X results in Y** = X هو السبب، Y هو النتيجة. Overfishing **results in** fewer fish.
**Y results from X** = Y هو النتيجة، X هو السبب. Fewer fish **result from** overfishing.
نفس المعنى بالظبط لكن الترتيب **مقلوب**. اقرا كويس قبل ما تجاوب.
وكمان **is caused by** (مبني للمجهول) السبب بييجي **بعدها**: Bleaching **is caused by** warm water.

blocks.text: سبب ونتيجة من غير كلمات ربط

text: Sometimes there is no signal word. You must understand the relationship from the meaning or from verbs such as **damage, threaten, reduce, increase, trigger, contribute to**.

blocks.text: مش دايمًا الكاتب هيكتب because أو as a result. ساعات بيستخدم **أفعال** معناها سبب ونتيجة، وساعات بيحط جملتين ورا بعض وإنت تفهم من المعنى.

items.en: The summer was extremely hot. Many farmers lost half of their crops.
items.ar: مفيش كلمة ربط، بس المعنى واضح: الحر الشديد (سبب) ← خسارة المحصول (نتيجة).

items.en: Supermarkets reject fruit with small marks on its skin. Tonnes of perfectly good apples never reach the shelves.
items.ar: السبب: السوبر ماركت بيرفض الفاكهة اللي فيها علامات. النتيجة: أطنان تفاح ميوصلش الرفوف.

blocks.title: خلي بالك: «مرتبط» مش معناه «سبب أكيد»
blocks.text: لما النص يقول **is linked to** أو **is associated with** أو **may cause** يبقى الكاتب بيقول إن فيه علاقة بس **مش متأكد 100%**. فلو سؤال True/False قال «The text proves that X causes Y» والنص قال «X **may be linked to** Y» يبقى الإجابة غالبًا **False** لأن النص مقالش «proves».
إزاي تقرا نص معلوماتي وتطلّع الأسباب والنتائج؟

items: **اعرف المشكلة الأساسية** من العنوان وأول فقرة (مثلًا: food waste أو coral bleaching).
**علّم على كلمات الربط** (because, due to, as a result, leads to …) وإنت بتقرا.
**لكل كلمة ربط اسأل:** اللي قبلها سبب ولا نتيجة؟ واللي بعدها إيه؟
**ارسم السلسلة** بأسهم صغيرة في الهامش: سبب ← نتيجة ← نتيجة.
**افصل بين الأسباب الكتير والنتائج الكتير:** ساعات حاجة واحدة ليها 3 أسباب، وساعات سبب واحد ليه نتايج كتير.
**ارجع للسؤال:** هو عايز **السبب** (Why … ? / What causes … ?) ولا **النتيجة** (What happens when … ? / What is the effect of … ?)؟

rows: Why …? / What causes …? / What is the reason for …?
because, due to, since, caused by, result from
What is the effect / result / consequence of …?
so, as a result, leads to, results in, therefore
اسم Y في النص والفعل اللي قبله
will / could / would + الفعل، أو جمل الشرط

blocks.text: نص للشرح (Report)
النص ده مكتوب للتدريب على موضوع Unit 4 (هدر الأكل). اقراه وبعدين شوف إزاي فكّكناه.

text: **Why Good Food Ends Up in the Bin**
(1) Around the world, roughly one third of the food produced for people is never eaten. This report looks at why so much food is wasted and what this waste means for households and for the planet.

(2) Waste begins long before food reaches our kitchens. Because supermarkets prefer fruit and vegetables that look perfect, farmers often throw away produce with small marks or unusual shapes. In hot countries, poor storage is another cause. Without refrigerated lorries, milk and fish can spoil during a single journey.

(3) At home, the main causes are poor planning and confusing labels. Many families shop without a list, so they buy more than they can use. Others misunderstand the difference between a 'best before' date, which is about quality, and a 'use by' date, which is about safety. As a result, they throw away food that is still perfectly safe to eat. Special occasions add to the problem: during large family meals, hosts often cook far more than guests can eat.

(4) The effects are serious. Financially, an average family may lose a significant part of its monthly food budget. Environmentally, wasted food that ends up in landfill produces methane, a greenhouse gas which is far more powerful than carbon dioxide. Wasted food also means wasted water, energy and land, all of which were used to grow, transport and package it.

(5) The report concludes that small changes can make a big difference. Planning meals, storing food correctly and sharing extra food with neighbours or charities can reduce waste, save money and protect the environment at the same time.

blocks.text: تفكيك النص: الأسباب والنتائج

rows: farmers throw away produce with marks or unusual shapes
milk and fish spoil during a journey
they buy more than they can use
hosts cook too much at large meals
less waste, saved money, protected environment

blocks.text: لاحظ إن الفقرة 4 كلها **نتائج (effects)**: نتيجة مالية (financially) ونتيجة بيئية (environmentally). والكاتب بدأها بجملة «**The effects are serious.**» علشان يقولك: من هنا هتلاقي النتايج.
وده مثال على **سلسلة (chain)** من النص:

items.en: No shopping list → buying too much → food goes off → food is thrown away → methane in landfill
items.ar: خمس حلقات: كل حلقة نتيجة للي قبلها وسبب للي بعدها. أسئلة «explain how X leads to Y» عايزاك تشرح الحلقات اللي في النص.

items.en: Wasted food also means wasted water, energy and land.
items.ar: نتيجة **مش مباشرة**: لما الأكل بيترمي، كل الموارد اللي اتصرفت عليه بتضيع كمان. الفعل **means** هنا بيدل على نتيجة.

blocks.title: أشهر الأخطاء (غلط ← صح)
items: ✗ بتقلب الاتجاه: «Methane causes food waste.» ← ✓ «Food waste in landfill **produces** methane.»
✗ بتفتكر إن اللي بعد **because of** نتيجة. ← ✓ اللي بعد because of / due to دايمًا **سبب**.
✗ بتجاوب بسبب واحد والسؤال طالب **two causes**. ← ✓ عدّ الأسباب في الفقرة: poor planning + confusing labels.
✗ بتكتب سبب من **فقرة تانية** غير اللي السؤال حددها. ← ✓ لو السؤال قال «According to paragraph 3» دوّر في الفقرة 3 بس.
✗ بتقول «النص أثبت» والنص قال «may / is linked to». ← ✓ فرّق بين **cause** أكيد و**link** محتمل.

blocks.title: إزاي تجاوب في الامتحان
items: سؤال **Why** ابدأ إجابتك بـ **Because …** أو **This is due to …**
سؤال **effect** ابدأ بـ **As a result, …** أو **This leads to …**
سؤال **explain** جاوب بالسلسلة: «X causes Y, which then leads to Z.»
سؤال **evaluate** (هل الأدلة كافية؟): قول نوع الدليل (رقم / مثال / خبير) وهل هو كفاية، زي ما الكتاب بيسأل في Unit 5: «Do you think the writer provides enough evidence …?»

blocks.text: إزاي بييجي في الأسئلة؟
**النوع 1 — Choose the correct answer:**

text: According to paragraph 3, families throw away safe food because they ______
a. buy food without checking its price
b. confuse 'best before' with 'use by' dates
c. do not have refrigerated lorries
d. prefer fruit that looks perfect

blocks.text: الإجابة **b**. السؤال حدد **paragraph 3** وقال **safe food**. الجملة في النص: «Others misunderstand the difference … As a result, they throw away food that is still perfectly safe». (c) و(d) أسباب حقيقية بس في **الفقرة 2** ومش عن الأكل الـ safe في البيت.
**النوع 2 — Explain (سلسلة):**

text: Q: Explain how shopping without a list can harm the environment. Use the text.

Model answer: When families shop without a list, they buy more than they can use, so some food goes off and is thrown away. This wasted food often ends up in landfill, where it produces methane, a greenhouse gas which is far more powerful than carbon dioxide. In addition, the water, energy and land used to produce the food are wasted.

blocks.text: الإجابة ربطت فقرة 3 بفقرة 4 وعملت سلسلة كاملة بكلمات ربط (so, where, In addition).
**النوع 3 — True / False + Justification:**

text: Statement: According to the report, food waste only affects families' money.
Answer: False. Justification: «**Environmentally, wasted food that ends up in landfill produces methane**».

blocks.text: كلمة **only** في الجملة هي الفخ: النص ذكر نتيجة مالية **ونتيجة بيئية**.
تدريب
**التدريب الأول:** في كل جملة حدد **السبب (C)** و**النتيجة (E)**.

items.q: 1. Due to rising temperatures, coral reefs are losing their colour.
items.a: **C:** rising temperatures — **E:** coral reefs are losing their colour. (due to + السبب)

items.q: 2. Hurricanes have become more intense, so many coastal families have been forced to move.
items.a: **C:** more intense hurricanes — **E:** families forced to move. (so + النتيجة)

items.q: 3. Deforestation results in the loss of biodiversity.
items.a: **C:** deforestation — **E:** loss of biodiversity. (results **in** = النتيجة بعدها)

items.q: 4. The loss of biodiversity results from deforestation.
items.a: **C:** deforestation — **E:** loss of biodiversity. نفس المعنى، بس results **from** = السبب بعدها.

items.q: 5. Many shoppers spend more than they planned. One reason is the countdown clocks used during online sales.
items.a: **C:** countdown clocks — **E:** shoppers spend more than planned. (One reason is = السبب)

items.q: 6. Ocean acidification is caused by the sea absorbing carbon dioxide.
items.a: **C:** the sea absorbing carbon dioxide — **E:** ocean acidification. (is caused by + السبب)

blocks.text: **التدريب التاني:** اقرا النص ده (Unit 5) وجاوب.

text: **When the Sea Turns White**

(1) Coral reefs cover less than one per cent of the ocean floor, yet they support around a quarter of all marine species. Today, these underwater cities are in danger, and the Red Sea, famous for its colourful reefs, is not completely safe.

(2) The main threat is warmer water. Corals live together with tiny algae that give them food and colour. When the sea becomes too hot for several weeks, the corals push the algae out. Consequently, they turn white, a process known as bleaching. Bleached corals are not dead, but they are starving, and if the heat continues, many of them die.

(3) Warmer water is not the only problem. Because the ocean absorbs carbon dioxide from the air, sea water is slowly becoming more acidic. This acidification makes it harder for corals to build their skeletons. In addition, careless tourism damages reefs directly: divers who touch or stand on coral can break pieces that took decades to grow.

(4) The loss of reefs would affect people as well as fish. Reefs protect coastlines from strong waves, and thousands of jobs in diving, fishing and hotels depend on them. Scientists say that cutting emissions, creating protected marine areas and training tourist guides could give reefs a better chance of recovery.

items.q:
7. According to paragraph 2, corals turn white because ______
a. divers touch them
b. they push out the algae when the water is too hot
c. they absorb too much carbon dioxide
d. fish eat the algae
items.a: **b** — «When the sea becomes too hot … the corals push the algae out. **Consequently**, they turn white». (a) و(c) أسباب لمشاكل تانية في الفقرة 3.

items.q:
8. The word «Consequently» in paragraph 2 introduces ______
a. a cause  b. an example  c. a result  d. a contrast
items.a: **c** — consequently = ونتيجة لكده. بعدها النتيجة (they turn white).

items.q:
9. Which of the following is NOT mentioned as a cause of damage to reefs?
a. warmer water  b. acidification  c. careless tourism  d. plastic bags
items.a: **d** — الأكياس البلاستيك مش مذكورة. سؤال NOT محتاج تشطب اللي موجود في النص.

items.q:
10. Complete the chain from paragraph 3:
The ocean absorbs carbon dioxide → ______ → corals find it harder to build their skeletons.
items.a: **sea water becomes more acidic (acidification)** — دي الحلقة اللي في النص.

items.q:
11. State whether the statement is True (T) or False (F). Justify your answer.
Bleached corals are already dead.
items.a: **False** — Justification: «**Bleached corals are not dead, but they are starving**».

items.q:
12. State whether the statement is True (T) or False (F). Justify your answer.
The loss of coral reefs would have effects on people's jobs.
items.a: **True** — Justification: «**thousands of jobs in diving, fishing and hotels depend on them**».

items.q: 13. Find a sentence in paragraph 4 that shows reefs protect people.
items.a: «**Reefs protect coastlines from strong waves**» — دي نتيجة مفيدة للبشر.

items.q: 14. What TWO effects on people would the loss of reefs have? Answer in your own words.
items.a: 1) Coasts would be less protected from strong waves. 2) Many people who work in diving, fishing and tourism could lose their jobs. — الكاتب بدأ الفقرة بـ «affect people as well as fish».

items.q:
15. Choose an appropriate heading for paragraph 3.
a. More Than One Danger
b. How Algae Feed Corals
c. The Best Places to Dive
d. Good News for Reefs
items.a: **a** — الفقرة بدأت بـ «Warmer water is not the only problem» وذكرت سببين تانيين.

blocks.text: **التدريب التالت:** اختار كلمة الربط المناسبة اللي تخلي معنى السبب والنتيجة صح.

items.q:
16. ______ poor storage, a lot of fruit spoils before it reaches the market.
a. As a result  b. Due to  c. So  d. Because
items.a: **b** — بعدها **اسم** (poor storage) فمحتاجين due to. because محتاجة جملة كاملة.

items.q:
17. The family did not plan their meals. ______, they threw away a lot of bread.
a. Because of  b. Since  c. As a result  d. Owing to
items.a: **c** — بعد نقطة وفي أول جملة جديدة فيها **النتيجة**.

items.q:
18. Burning fossil fuels ______ global warming.
a. results from  b. is caused by  c. contributes to  d. is due to
items.a: **c** — burning fossil fuels هو **السبب**، فمحتاجين فعل بعده النتيجة. (a) و(b) و(d) بيقلبوا الاتجاه.

items.q:
19. ______ the sea is getting warmer, many fish are moving north.
a. Since  b. Due to  c. Consequently  d. Because of
items.a: **a** — بعدها جملة كاملة (the sea is getting) وهي **السبب**.

blocks.text: **التدريب الرابع (JRE والتحليل):**

items.q: 20. In «Why Good Food Ends Up in the Bin», which cause of food waste do you think is the easiest to solve? Justify your answer with evidence from the text.
items.a: Model: I think poor planning is the easiest cause to solve. This is because it does not need money or new technology. According to the text, many families shop without a list, so they buy more than they can use. A simple list could therefore prevent a lot of waste. — J + R + E + شرح.

items.q: 21. Do you think the writer of «When the Sea Turns White» provides enough evidence to convince readers that reefs are in danger? Why or why not?
items.a: Model: Partly. The writer explains clearly how heat causes bleaching and gives a fact about reefs supporting a quarter of marine species. However, there are no numbers showing how many reefs have already been lost, so more statistics would make the text more convincing. — نفس سؤال الكتاب في Unit 5.

items.q: 22. Explain how warmer water can lead to the death of corals. Use the cause-and-effect chain in the text.
items.a: Model: When the water stays too hot for several weeks, corals push out the algae that give them food. As a result, they turn white and start starving. If the heat continues, many of them die. — سلسلة من 3 حلقات بكلمات ربط.

blocks.title: ملخص الدرس في سطرين
items: **Cause** = ليه حصل؟ **Effect** = حصل إيه بعد كده؟ السبب دايمًا بيحصل **الأول**.
بعد **because / since / due to / owing to / caused by / result from** = **سبب**.
بعد **so / as a result / consequently / therefore / lead to / result in** = **نتيجة**.
خلي بالك من **result in ≠ result from**، ومن **linked to / may** (علاقة محتملة مش أكيدة).
في الإجابة اعمل **سلسلة**: X causes Y, which leads to Z — واستشهد بجملة من الفقرة المطلوبة.
